'''Droideka Gamma''' was a reprogrammed [[Droideka/Legends|droideka]] and part of [[IG-88's Droid Army]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was part of a radical group of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that planned to start a [[Droid Revolution]] before they were destroyed in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]].
